label: Profile Editor
description: Sheet holding a profile form. Best for a right side profile editor with 2 fields, Save changes and Cancel in a footer that stays, and the corner close button.

label: No Close Button
description: Sheet without a corner close button. Best for the profile editor without the corner X, leaving the footer's Cancel as the visible way out.

label: Any Side
description: Sheets that open from any side. Best for one trigger per edge, top, right, bottom and left, with top and bottom sheets held to half the screen.

label: Scrollable Content
description: Sheet with scrolling content. Best for a long body that scrolls between a fixed header and a Save and Cancel footer.
